text:
Mira: Heads-up: group sync flagged auth path ambiguity — intent-scoped keys vs operator-bridge. need a short checklist.
Juan: Short take: direct claims = low latency; operator-bridge = better isolation.
Alex: Proposed policy: gateway decides per-route. public multi-tenant -> intent-hash path; internal/single-tenant -> direct claim. operator-bridge only when true anonymization required.
Kevin: Billing quandary: intent-hash hides raw org id. we need server-attached billing headers to attribute quota. e.g. `x-billing-org: org-123` injected after policy.
infra-bot: canary deploy: billing-header-hook v1 -> /v1/embedding (no errors)
Sam: Migration notes: accept legacy keys for 180 days; nudge rotation; SDKs to surface `x-intent-bound` header to avoid misrouting long jobs.
Mira: Sample JWT for intent-hash flow:
```jwt
{"sub":"svc-worker","intent":"embed:create","org_hash":"sha256:abcd1234","exp":1890000000}
```
Juan: Edge: mixed-tenant queues force operator-bridge per-item tokens -> high token churn. maybe prefer intent-hash + server-side attribution for queue processors.
Alex: RBAC: support prefix grouping so `embed:create` checks can fall back to `embed:*` or `embed` role. reduces role explosion.
Kevin: Action items: I will draft billing header spec (format, TTL, signing). Juan: list services that must remain direct-claims. Sam: write migration mini-RFC + nginx-lua snippet. Mira: schedule follow-up next Tue. :thumbsup:
